description: Compare two consecutive versions of a served dataset row by row on its key fields, to see what a publisher changed between releases. from and to must be adjacent dates in the version history from get_dataset, older first. Any other pair returns a 404 error, so step through a longer span one pair at a time. A dataset with no key, which list_fields shows as an empty key, gets row counts only, and a dataset with one version has nothing to compare. The call costs nothing against the rate limit.
name: diff_versions

examples.description: Up to ten changed rows, each with its key and the fields that changed from and to

key.description: Key fields compared on. Empty when none is declared

note.description: Present when no key is declared and only row counts are compared

schema.description: Fields added, removed and retyped between the versions

truncated.description: True when a key list stops at its cap

title: Compare versions
